card.name: Of after a risk estimate
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "of" right after a relative-risk figure with a confidence interval, just before the outcome (e.g. suicidal thinking). Also fires on a few other linking words or commas in statistical risk and rate statements.

modes.label: Of after risk ratio
modes.description: The word "of" directly after a parenthetical risk estimate and confidence interval, before the outcome.
modes.example: s had approximately twice the risk (adjusted Relative Risk 1.8, 95% CI:1.2, 2.7)<< of>> suicidal thinking or behavior compared to patients randomized

modes.label: Other words in rate statements
modes.description: A linking word or comma inside a sentence reporting rates or counts of an outcome.
modes.example: In India, the<< age>> standardized incidence rate of oral cancer is

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning "frequently", so it mildly steers away from frequency adverbs.
card.plain: It fires on the small word "of" in sentences reporting how much the risk of an outcome is raised.
